assessment: This useful article focuses on understanding how an Eklf mutation confers anti-cancer and longevity advantages in vivo. The data demonstrate that Eklf (K74R) imparts such advantages in a background- and age-independent manner in both female and male mice, and that the benefits are transferable by bone marrow transplantation. Despite added data since a previous version, the article unfortunately remains incomplete as it is still unclear whether Eklf affects resistance to malignant progression/metastasis by modulating Pd1 or Pdl1 or by increasing NK cells. The authors provide evidence that supports in principle both mechanisms, and they do not resolve which mechanism is primarily involved.
